description:
BF16 Q + MXFP8 SWA + NVFP4 compressed KV Excludes indexer/cache writer/projection/RoPE/Mega/full model and steady-state performance D512/V512 MQA; S1/3, physical H64/128, TP1/2/4/8; SWA128 plus compressed Top512, ratio0/1/2. Decode/MTP; no long-prefill claim.

Production entry: flash_mla_cuda.sparse_decode_fwd; fixed source revision 0eee43b12f034b657133cf2afca6a72ebb6efccf.

Parameter domain: shape_range.json defines dynamic request ranges and correlated model/ABI constraints; shape_cases.json fixes 10 representative workloads, not the complete support domain. Dynamic batch/context, Q=1 or3; physical_heads64/128 are the real ABI dimensions. tp=1 is descriptive, not an additional head division. No measured traffic weights are claimed. Existing GPU evidence covers only the unchanged fixed sample, not every point in this dynamic domain.

Input construction: Logical selection and physical placement are independently declared. Contiguous placement keeps neighboring logical tokens/pages contiguous; scattered placement permutes physical allocation. Selectors cover score-related, local, strided, shared-prefix and random sets. Score selection uses the same generated cache/query features (first eight channels; QSA averages four-token block scores), with causal visibility, budget, tail and invalid-marker rules preserved. Q/K latent-topic structure is synthetic; the indexer itself remains outside the timed core. Record actual physical selected-token count, unique pages, density and adjacent-query Jaccard on up to sixteen query rows. Context length is not equated with selected work. Page layout, scale packing, SWA/compressed aliases and output ABI remain unchanged. Native source csrc/api/sparse_decode.cpp supports physical H64/H128. Current normal inputs use all physical heads; the old artificial H/tp active-head masking is removed. tp is fixed to1 in this domain, with no implied TP speedup and no new padding. This is the native H64/H128 no-split contract, not a claim that an arbitrary smaller-head caller should pad to it.

validation.correctness_scope: Original library, validation_scope=sampled, SM103; fixed shape IDs 0-9, at most 2 recorded seeds per shape. 采样通过. Counts={'passed': 20}. No prior patched results inherited. Shared-GPU timings are execution checks only.

limitations: No deployment-specific frequency or device-time weight is claimed.

real_inputs.reason: General source-derived shapes and stored-precision synthetic payloads; real traffic is not part of this core contract.
